note: Values are approximate market estimates in USD based on BUC Book guide values and comparable Yachtworld listings at time of database creation. Actual value depends on condition, equipment, location, and current market. Always verify with a current BUCValu subscription and live Yachtworld comparable listings.

values.rationale: Alberg 30 is a classic Canadian-designed offshore cruiser. Well-maintained examples with updated standing rigging, updated sails, and reasonable equipment command the higher end. Common in the Maritimes and Great Lakes. Older construction means more due diligence on osmotic blistering and structural integrity is warranted.
Alberg 35 is a well-regarded blue-water cruiser. Pricing reflects overall condition and equipment upgrades. Examples with recent haul-out, bottom work, and engine service fetch premium pricing.

Bavaria 32 Cruiser is a popular European production cruiser with good build quality. Canadian market pricing is affected by exchange rates. Well-equipped examples with full electronics packages and recent service records command premium pricing.

Bavaria 39 Cruiser offers good volume and sailing performance. Market value is supported by the model's popularity as a live-aboard and coastal cruiser. Condition and equipment level are primary drivers of value within this range.

The First 36.7 is a highly regarded performance cruiser-racer with a strong following. Racing inventory, electronics, and recent servicing are key value drivers. Examples with updated standing rigging and quality sails command the higher end of the range.

First 40.7 is one of the most respected performance cruisers of its era. Strong demand and limited supply support pricing. Full racing inventory, quality electronics, and well-maintained deck hardware are key value determinants.

Beneteau Oceanis 35 is a popular family cruiser with strong resale value. Pricing reflects overall condition, equipment level, and sail inventory. Newer examples with full electronics packages command a premium.
The 35.1 redesign improved accommodation and performance. Strong demand in the Canadian market supports pricing. Lightly used examples with quality equipment packages approach the top of the range.
Oceanis 38 is a well-equipped family cruiser with a loyal following. Pricing is well-supported by the model's performance and accommodation. Three-cabin layout is particularly popular with families.
The Oceanis 40.1 is a modern design with strong demand. As a current production model, pricing is well supported. Examples with full electronics and comfort packages command premium pricing.

Oceanis 45 commands strong resale values in the Canadian market. The 4-cabin layout is particularly popular. Pricing is influenced by equipment level, condition of sails, and whether the vessel has been professionally maintained.

The 46.1 represents the current production offering at this size. Strong demand and relatively limited supply of lightly used examples supports pricing at the upper range. Full-spec examples with watermaker, generator, and full electronics can command further premiums.
Oceanis 48 is a capable offshore passagemaker and popular charter vessel. Pricing reflects strong demand for this size range. Five-cabin layouts with two heads are particularly sought after.

The C&C 30 is a Canadian classic with strong following in the Great Lakes. Well-maintained examples with recent engine and rigging work command the higher end. Popular for racing and coastal cruising.

C&C 33 remains a competitive club racer and capable cruiser. Pricing is supported by the model's reputation for quality construction and performance. Condition and equipment package are primary value drivers.
C&C 34 is a well-balanced cruiser-racer with quality Canadian construction. Examples with updated electronics, new standing rigging, and quality sails fetch the higher end of this range.

The C&C 35 Mk III is a popular cruiser-racer with strong Canadian market demand. Quality construction and sailing performance maintain resale values. Condition, equipment, and recent upgrades are key value factors.

C&C 38 is a well-regarded offshore cruiser-racer with proven bluewater capabilities. Pricing reflects condition, equipment level, and offshore readiness. Examples with recent engine overhaul and updated standing rigging command premium pricing.

CS 27 is a popular Canadian starter cruiser with a loyal following in the Great Lakes and Maritimes. Pricing reflects the age and production volume. Well-maintained examples with working systems command the higher end.
CS 30 is a capable coastal cruiser with strong Canadian market presence. Pricing reflects condition and equipment level. Recent engine work and updated standing rigging are important value factors.
CS 33 offers comfortable accommodation for a 33-foot cruiser. Canadian construction quality and practical layout support resale values. Condition of hull, engine, and sails are primary value drivers.

CS 36 is a well-rounded offshore capable cruiser popular in Canadian waters. Good accommodation and practical layout maintain demand. Recent service history and equipment upgrades command premium pricing.

CS 40 is one of the most capable production cruisers from this era. Strong demand and limited supply support pricing. Well-equipped examples ready for offshore passages command the higher end of the range.

Catalina 320 offers good accommodation and sailing performance for a family cruiser. High production numbers support parts availability and market liquidity. Condition and equipment level are the primary value drivers.

Catalina 34 is a perennial bestseller with strong resale values. Comfortable accommodation for a 34-foot boat supports demand. Recent Atomic 4 to diesel engine conversions can add value significantly.

Catalina 36 Mk II is one of the most popular production cruisers in North America. Strong demand and widespread familiarity support resale values. Wing keel and shoal draft options are popular in Great Lakes markets.

Catalina 380 offers premium accommodation and sailing performance. Strong demand for this size in the Canadian market supports pricing. Recent standing rigging replacement and full electronics package are key value drivers.

Catalina 42 remains in strong demand as a blue-water capable family cruiser. Three-cabin layout, good standing headroom, and sailing performance support values. Equipment level and offshore readiness are key pricing factors.

Contessa 26 has a legendary offshore reputation including numerous ocean voyages and races. The model's proven seaworthiness and cult following support values disproportionate to its age. Condition and recent servicing are critical value factors.

Hallberg-Rassy quality commands a significant premium in the market. The 34 is highly regarded for offshore capability and Swedish build quality. Strong international demand supports pricing. Condition of teak decks, standing rigging, and electronics are key value factors.

HR 37 is one of the most respected production cruising sailboats. Exceptional build quality and offshore capability command significant premiums over comparable size production cruisers. Condition and equipment level remain primary value drivers.

HR 40 is a serious blue-water passagemaker with exceptional quality. Limited production and strong demand support premium pricing. Full equipment packages with watermaker, generator, and modern electronics are expected at this price point.

HR 43 represents a significant investment in quality offshore cruising capability. High build standards, premium materials, and excellent resale value retention define this model. Thoroughly equipped examples with extensive electronics and safety equipment command the higher end.

Hunter 33 is a popular family cruiser with good accommodation and shoal draft options popular in the Great Lakes. Pricing reflects condition and equipment level. Shoal draft versions are particularly sought after in shallow-water markets.

Hunter 36 offers excellent accommodation for its size with practical layouts favored by cruising families. Pricing reflects condition, equipment level, and sail inventory. Recent standing rigging and electronics upgrades add value.

Hunter 38 is a capable family cruiser with a comfortable layout and good performance. Pricing reflects the model's strong market acceptance and equipment level. The island berth aft cabin layout is particularly sought after.

Island Packet shoal-draft designs command premiums for their offshore capability and build quality. The IP 350 is a proven blue-water cruiser with strong following. Equipment level and offshore readiness are key pricing factors.

IP 370 combines comfortable accommodation with true offshore cruising capability. Build quality and reputation command premiums over comparable size production cruisers. Watermaker, generator, and full electronics are typical equipment at this price point.

IP 420 is a premier blue-water cruiser with exceptional build quality and offshore capability. High demand from experienced cruisers supports strong resale values. Fully equipped examples with watermaker, generator, and SSB are expected at this price point.

Sun Odyssey 349 is a popular family cruiser with modern design and good sailing performance. Strong Jeanneau resale values support pricing. Full electronics and comfortable interior packages are key value drivers.

SO 379 offers excellent accommodation and sailing performance for a 37-foot cruiser. Jeanneau's reputation for quality construction supports resale values. Condition and equipment level are primary value drivers.

SO 409 is a well-regarded passage-capable cruiser with comfortable offshore accommodations. Strong demand for this size range supports pricing. Three-cabin layouts with two heads are particularly sought after.

SO 44i offers an attractive combination of performance, accommodation, and value. Pricing is well-supported by strong demand in the Canadian market. Equipment level, sail inventory, and offshore equipment are key value determinants.

Nonsuch 26 is a Canadian design with a unique unstayed cat-rig. Strong following among sailing enthusiasts who appreciate the simple sailing system. Condition of the wishbone rig and sail inventory are critical value factors.

Nonsuch 30 is a popular Canadian-designed cat-rigged cruiser. The simple sailing system and comfortable accommodation create strong demand. Well-maintained examples with good sails and recent engine work command the higher end.

Nonsuch 33 offers exceptional accommodation for its size with the practical cat-rig system. Limited production and dedicated following support pricing. Condition of sails, rig, and engine are primary value factors.

Pacific Seacraft 34 is renowned for exceptional construction quality and offshore capability. Build quality and offshore reputation command significant premiums. Shoal draft version with comfortable accommodation is particularly sought after.
Tartan 3500 is a premium American-built cruiser-racer with excellent offshore capability. Quality construction and sailing performance command premiums over comparable production cruisers.

Tayana 37 is a proven offshore cruiser with a loyal following. Heavy displacement and traditional construction make it well-suited to ocean passages. Equipment level and offshore readiness are key value determinants.

Bayliner 2452 is a popular entry-level cabin cruiser with high production numbers. Pricing reflects condition, engine hours, and overall equipment state. High production numbers support parts availability.

Bayliner 2855 is a popular family cruiser with good accommodation and performance. Engine condition, hours, and overall maintenance record are primary value drivers. Twin-engine examples command a premium.
Carver 32 Mariner is a well-appointed family cruiser with quality construction and comfortable layout. Twin-engine configuration, engine hours, and overall systems condition are key value factors.

Carver 350 Mariner offers premium accommodation and twin-engine reliability. Pricing reflects engine condition, hours, and overall equipment state. Generator, air conditioning, and recent service history are important value factors.

Carver 380 Santego is a premium express cruiser with excellent layout and twin-engine reliability. Condition of engines, generator, and canvas work are primary value determinants. Full-spec examples with recent upgrades command the higher end.

Grand Banks 36 Classic commands significant premiums for quality construction and proven trawler design. The semi-displacement hull provides economical cruising. Engine condition, teak work, and overall systems are key value factors. Strongly maintained examples with documented service history are worth a premium.

Grand Banks 42 is one of the most sought-after trawler yachts. Quality construction, proven design, and strong following support values. Twin-screw, full teak interior, and salon arrangement are key features. Engine hours and generator condition are important considerations.

Mainship 30 Pilot is a practical and economical single-engine trawler. Diesel engine reliability and the pilot house layout make it popular for Canadian coastal cruising. Engine hours and overall systems condition are primary value factors.

Mainship 34 Pilot is a popular coastal trawler with pilot house and practical layout. Single Yanmar diesel and fuel-efficient operation make it economical to run. Condition and hours on the main engine are primary value drivers.

Mainship 43 Trawler is a capable and comfortable long-range cruiser. Twin-engine reliability and the traditional trawler design support strong values in the Canadian market. Generator condition, watermaker, and overall systems are key value factors.

Nordic Tug 32 commands premium pricing for quality construction and trawler-style design. Popular in BC and the Pacific Northwest. Engine hours, generator condition, and overall systems are key value factors. The pilothouse layout and fuel efficiency at displacement speeds are highly valued.

Nordic Tug 37 is one of the most respected trawler designs in the Pacific Northwest. Quality construction and practical layout support premium pricing. Full-spec examples with fly bridge, generator, and bow thruster command the higher end.

Ranger Tug 29 is a modern and popular coastal trawler with quality construction. The retractable bow thruster and fuel-efficient Volvo diesel are standard features. Pricing reflects condition and equipment level. Very popular in BC waters.

Sea Ray 260 Bow Rider is a gasoline sterndrive bowrider. Engine and outdrive condition, upholstery, canvas, trailer inclusion, and overall cosmetic condition are primary value factors. Strong Sea Ray brand recognition supports resale values.

Sea Ray 260 Sundancer is a popular express cruiser with reliable performance. Engine hours, condition of canvas and upholstery, and overall systems are key value factors. Strong brand recognition supports resale values.

Sea Ray 290 Sundancer offers comfortable accommodation and reliable twin-engine performance. Engine hours and condition, canvas work, and electronics are key value factors. The model's popularity ensures good market liquidity.

Sea Ray 310 Sundancer is a premium express cruiser with excellent layout and performance. Twin-engine reliability, generator, and air conditioning are important value factors. Strong Sea Ray brand commands premiums in the market.

Sea Ray 340 Sundancer is a premium express cruiser with excellent accommodation. Engine hours and condition, generator, and canvas work are primary value determinants. The model's strong brand and build quality support resale values.

Sea Ray 370 Sundancer commands premium pricing for its size, quality, and accommodation. Twin-engine reliability, generator, air conditioning, and full electronics are standard at this price point. Engine hours and overall condition are primary value drivers.
Silverton 31 Sedan is a practical family cruiser with good accommodation and twin-engine reliability. Engine condition, hours, and overall systems maintenance are key value factors.

Silverton 38 Convertible is a capable sport fishing and family cruising vessel. Twin-engine reliability, fish box, and convertible layout are key features. Engine hours, generator, and canvas condition are primary value determinants.
